followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the brief Taliban-imposed pedestrian interruption, separate from longer Pakistani entry controls. The documented return is stranded Afghan and Pakistani nationals going home. Goods, medical movement and evacuees had different permissions; no unrestricted Afghan entry is inferred. Retain September13–14,one calendar-day difference. Monday onset and Tuesday restored homeward passage are explicit; no measured24hours is claimed. Admission/document dispute and coercive-pressure coding remain attributed to the Pakistani border official’s account of the rejected Taliban demand, not proven private intentions. Fresh Anadolu onset and named-commissioner return reports were read; the Tribune403 was logged without inventing its text or independent corroboration. Retain the named Torkham passenger scope, unlocated geometry and null coordinates; no countrywide restriction drawn from a single gate.
